notes.title: Where The Death of Rebirth is at?
notes.notes:
[u][b][h1]Where were at with development?[/h1][/b][/u]

We're making significant updates to our Steam store page! This includes removing the current trailers and photos, revising the description, and continually updating the page as development progresses. Since the initial launch, much has evolved, and we want to keep you informed with the latest developments and patches. Follow our journey and stay updated on our website:[url=https://www.gabagoogames.ca/]gabagoogames.ca[/url]


[u][b][h2]What's Coming?[/h2][/b][/u]
Later this month, on August 17th, we'll be updating the store page for The Death of Rebirth. We'll showcase the revamped work with an Overview Map Teaser Trailer, highlighting the HUB area where players will load in each time they start the game after the main menu.


[u][b][h3]What's to come later this year?[/h3][/b][/u]
As we development and make more progress we'll be uploading devlog's to the Dans_Tip channel or showing teaser logs on our company Channel [url=https://www.youtube.com/@GabaGooGames]@GabaGooGames[/url]
Make sure to follow our progress on our website. Steam will also start getting each patch note as we move forward. We'll be running a Kickstarter later next month, some time after August 17th, 2024. More updates on that subject will be coming soon.

Check out the website!
GabaGoo Games.
